interpretation: Structural validity and traceability do not establish completeness or learner readiness. Higher-level sources, alternate paths, and other source outcomes are inspection signals, not automatic defects. Do not delete edges or split decks without evaluating their contracts.

exclusions.subject: biology
exclusions.rationale: Independent clinical practice, veterinary licensure and regulated diagnosis are separate professional qualifications; biological mechanisms are taught in biology/pathobiology.

exclusions.subject: chemistry
exclusions.rationale: Plant-wide engineering qualification and detailed equipment codes exceed this chemistry curriculum; bounded reactor, separation and hazard capabilities are included in chemistry/process-chemistry.

exclusions.subject: physics
exclusions.rationale: Aviation, nuclear-operation and medical-physics authorization require separate accredited professional training, beyond physical theory and experimental competence.

exclusions.subject: mathematics
exclusions.rationale: Large-cardinal theory and inner-model research are specialist extensions; formal foundations remain included in mathematics/mathematical-logic through formal-semantics, completeness-compactness and incompleteness.

exclusions.subject: computer-science
exclusions.rationale: This proposal includes formal-methods foundations and reliable-learning research, but not an exhaustive catalog of specialized verification logics or frontier learning architectures.
